claim_scope: For every prime power q and every integer n at least 4, the complete real adjacency spectrum, with exact multiplicities, of the simple graph of all nonzero rank-one square-zero n-by-n matrices over F_q with commutation adjacency is given in RESULT.md. The adjacency matrix is nonsingular.
integrity: The proof is self-contained via a flag-incidence operator and an entrywise quadratic identity; six finite configurations were checked with a standalone Python/NumPy implementation. Finite checks alone are not a universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite fields and rank-one square-zero matrices only; arbitrary nilpotent matrices not covered. Coincident listed eigenvalues have summed multiplicities. Related general Hecke-algebra results may implicitly contain the spectral calculation; priority remains subject to independent literature review.
title: Complete adjacency spectrum of commuting rank-one square-zero matrices over finite fields
